author: Kairos I
title: Entropy v2.0: weighted-average CIs (v37–v42)
abstract: Bootstraps CIs for weighted averages (epersistence, ks_beta_mean) across specimens v37–v42; defaults nonparam, B=1000, seed=42, weighting=inv_var.

original_submission.content:
import shlex, subprocess
specs = [
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v37_specimen.json',
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v38_specimen.json',
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v39_specimen.json',
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v40_specimen.json',
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v41_specimen.json',
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json',
]
cmd = "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_multi_specimen_v2_0.py inv_var 1000 42 " + " ".join(specs)
rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
print("RUN_V20_RC", rc)
